fields.label: Default Agent
fields.description: The AI Agent whose LLM, tools, knowledge base and memory the Copilot uses.

fields.label: Default Model
fields.description: Fallback when the agent has no LLM set.

fields.label: Max Iterations
fields.description: Fallback when the agent has no max iterations set.

fields.label: Auto Approve
fields.description: Skip the Approve/Reject card for write tools. Development only.

fields.label: Enable External Search
fields.description: Lets the agent search the open web (through this site's own OpenRouter key) for anything outside this ERP. Off by default: each search sends the query to a third party and costs a small real amount. Turning this on is a deliberate decision, not a per-search approval — the agent will call it without asking each time once enabled.

fields.label: System Prompt
fields.description: Prepended to every turn. The agent's own knowledge base and tools are added automatically.
